Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets.surveyreports

package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets.surveyreports
Provides the tabular data sets that publish the survey reports, and the annotations within them, that the open survey framework has stored in open metadata.
